lines.en: label otohapark5:
scene otohacafetrip1
It doesn’t take long to find Otoha once I make my way over to the park again.
lines.zh: 再次往公园那边走，没花多久就找到了 Otoha。

lines.en: In fact, she winds up spotting me first and trots over without me even having to ask.
lines.zh: 事实上，是她先看到了我，我没开口她就小跑过来了。

lines.en: This is good.
lines.zh: 这很好。

lines.en: If she keeps growing at this rate, she might just wind up walking over to my house in the morning and, eventually, I won’t need to leave at all.
lines.zh: 照她这个成长速度下去，说不定哪天她早上会直接走到我家来，最后我连门都不用出了。

lines.en: : I’ll leave a key for you under the doormat.
lines.zh: : 我会在门垫下面给你留把钥匙。

lines.en: : Key? What?
lines.zh: : 钥匙？什么？

lines.en: : What are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 你在说什么啊？

lines.en: : Just the bright future the two of us have together...
lines.zh: : 只是说说我们俩一起拥有的光明未来……

lines.en: : Oh. Uhh, okay. Whatever floats your boat.
lines.zh: : 哦。呃，好吧。你高兴就好。

lines.en: : No guitar today either?
lines.zh: : 今天也没带吉他？

lines.en: scene otohacafetrip2
: Not really any point until it gets a little warmer.
lines.zh: : 等再暖和点才有意义吧。

lines.en: : The other day would have been fine, but it’s back to being chilly again and I don’t want to wind up botching any of my songs when I’m still not known around here.
lines.zh: : 前几天的天气倒还行，可现在又冷回去了，我在这儿还没什么名气，可不想把歌给弹砸了。

lines.en: : Just buy hand warmers or something. Problem solved.
lines.zh: : 那就买个暖手宝什么的。问题解决。

lines.en: scene otohacafetrip3
: Sure, that’ll solve my finger stiffness...but it’s not like everybody will come flocking to the park as soon as they hear that some random girl bought handwarmers.
lines.zh: : 是啊，那能解决我手指僵硬的问题……可总不至于大家一听说有个不认识的女生买了暖手宝，就全都涌到公园来吧。

lines.en: : There’s more than just one problem, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 问题可不止一个啊，Sensei。

lines.en: : Why not play indoors then?
lines.zh: : 那为什么不在室内弹？

lines.en: : What, you mean at that gazebo thing over there? That’s not really going to do much.
lines.zh: : 什么，你是说那边那个凉亭之类的？那也起不了多大作用。

lines.en: : I meant something more like an actual business. Like some local venue or a-
lines.zh: : 我指的是更像真正的商铺那种。比如本地的演出场地，或者——

lines.en: scene otohacafetrip4
: Cafe!
lines.zh: : 咖啡厅！

lines.en: : Holy shit! Yeah! That place where Rin works would be great to play at!
lines.zh: : 我靠！对啊！Rin 打工的那地方就很适合弹！

lines.en: : People actually go there in the morning and there’s like...tons of space!
lines.zh: : 早上真的会有人去那儿，而且还有……特别大的空间！

lines.en: : Also, the manager there really has a thing for [teenage]girls. So you’re basically already locked in.
lines.zh: : 而且那儿的店长特别喜欢[teenage]女孩。所以你基本已经内定了。

lines.en: scene otohacafetrip5
: You know, maybe we should think of other places just in case. The cafe is cool and all, but-
lines.zh: : 我说，要不我们还是再想想别的地方以防万一吧。咖啡厅是挺不错，不过——

lines.en: : Don’t worry. She’s still running a business, so it’s not like she’ll make a move on you mid-set or anything.
lines.zh: : 别担心。她毕竟还在做生意，总不至于在你演到一半的时候对你下手什么的。

lines.en: scene otohacafetrip3
: Is that supposed to make me more comfortable?...
lines.zh: : 你这么说是在让我安心吗？……

lines.en: : Hey. As a female musician, and a rather attractive one, might I add-
lines.zh: : 嘿。作为一名女性音乐人，而且还是相当有魅力的那种，容我补充一句——

lines.en: : You really didn’t have to add that.
lines.zh: : 你真的没必要补这一句。

lines.en: : You should start getting used to being the center of attention. It’s only going to happen more once you start getting popular.
lines.zh: : 你该开始习惯成为众人目光的焦点了。等你火起来，这种事只会越来越多。

lines.en: : How do you think Niki feels? She’s on actual billboards and she loves the attention.
lines.zh: : 你觉得 Niki 会怎么想？她可是真的上了广告牌，而且她很享受那种目光。

lines.en: : Sure, yeah. But don’t you feel a little weird being her ex and knowing that there are a bunch of dudes out there who want to get it on with her?
lines.zh: : 是，没错。可你是她前任，明知道外面有一大堆男的想跟她上床，你不觉得有点别扭吗？

lines.en: : Not really. Because I know I’m the only one who has.
lines.zh: : 不怎么觉得。因为我知道，我是唯一一个得手的人。

lines.en: : Probably.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。

lines.en: : If you’re worried about her hooking up with anybody else, I know for a fact that she hasn’t.
lines.zh: : 如果你担心她跟别人搞上的话，我可以肯定地告诉你，她没有。

lines.en: : She’s really only ever talked about one guy and...that guy somehow wound up being you.
lines.zh: : 她真的只提过一个男人，而且……那个男人莫名其妙就成了你。

lines.en: : That’s cool. But I meant more that I haven’t exactly confirmed if {i}I{/i} have had sex with her yet.
lines.zh: : 挺好的。不过我的意思是，我还没确认过{i}我{/i}到底跟她做过没有。

lines.en: : How...can you not know that?
lines.zh: : 你怎么……会不知道这种事？

lines.en: scene otohacafetrip6
: Wait, she didn’t like...do stuff to you in your sleep or something...did she?
lines.zh: : 等等，她该不会……趁你睡着的时候对你做了什么吧……不会吧？

lines.en: : She very well may have done just that, Otoha...
lines.zh: : 她很可能就是这么干的，Otoha……

lines.en: : Oh my God. That’s so messed up.
lines.zh: : 我的天。这也太离谱了。

lines.en: : She’s kind of controlling though, so I guess I could see that.
lines.zh: : 不过她确实有点控制欲，所以我想这事我信。

lines.en: Sorry, Niki. I have tarnished your name once again.
lines.zh: 抱歉了，Niki。我又一次玷污了你的名声。

lines.en: Unless you actually {i}did{/i} assault me in my sleep.
lines.zh: 除非你真的{i}趁我睡着的时候{/i}侵犯了我。

lines.en: If that’s the case-
lines.zh: 如果是这样的话——

lines.en: Nice.
lines.zh: 不错。

lines.en: : But anyway, you should probably get used to people wanting to “get it on” with you.
lines.zh: : 总之呢，你大概该习惯有人想跟你“上床”这件事了。

lines.en: : That’s a little easier said than done, man...
lines.zh: : 这事说起来容易做起来难啊，老兄……

lines.en: : Well, if you’d like...I could help loosen you up a-
lines.zh: : 嗯，如果你愿意……我可以帮你放松一——

lines.en: scene otohacafetrip7
: Oh, look. Is that a police officer behind you?
lines.zh: : 哦，瞧。你身后那是警察吗？

lines.en: : I could help you learn to deal with any insecurities that may have led to your apparent disdain for unwarranted, romantically-focused attention from others.
lines.zh: : 我可以帮你学会应对那些不安——正是它们让你这么明显地反感别人无缘无故的、带恋爱意味的关注。

lines.en: scene otohacafetrip8
: Nah. I’m good.
lines.zh: : 不用了。我没事。

lines.en: : I’ll take my allowance now, though. I’m still waiting on that 1,000 yen.
lines.zh: : 不过我的零花钱现在该给我了吧。我还在等那一千日元呢。

lines.en: : Who are you, my [niece]?
lines.zh: : 你算什么，我的[niece]吗？

lines.en: scene otohacafetrip9
: Hmm...maybe more of a cool big sister.
lines.zh: : 嗯……也许更像个酷姐姐。

lines.en: : I guess little sister would also work given our current dynamic, though.
lines.zh: : 不过照我们现在的关系，说妹妹好像也行。

lines.en: : But we should probably stop talking about this before Nodoka shows up out of nowhere and tries to write some doujin about us.
lines.zh: : 不过我们最好别再聊这个了，免得 Nodoka 突然冒出来，想写点关于我们的同人志。

lines.en: scene otohacafetrip1
: Since you won't be giving any generous contributions to my music fund, do you want to at least take a trip to the cafe with me?
lines.zh: : 既然你不打算慷慨资助我的音乐基金，那至少陪我去一趟咖啡厅吧？

lines.en: : It's not like I have anything else going for me this morning since I don't have lessons.
lines.zh: : 反正我今天上午没课，也没别的事可做。

lines.en: : Plus, it will probably be really funny to see Rin’s reaction to the two of us showing up together.
lines.zh: : 而且看到我们俩一起出现时 Rin 的反应，肯定特别好笑。

lines.en: : I feel like she will either love it or absolutely hate it.
lines.zh: : 我觉得她要么爱死，要么恨死。

lines.en: : I’m leaning toward the former. I think she’ll be stoked to know that two of her confirmed “favorite people” have started hanging out.
lines.zh: : 我偏向前者。她要是知道她两个公认的“最喜欢的人”开始一起玩了，肯定会很兴奋。

lines.en: : Just wait until she learns we’re family now as well.
lines.zh: : 等她知道我们现在还是一家人，有她受的。

lines.en: scene otohacafetrip10
: Come on, big bro! Let’s go torment our favorite barista!
lines.zh: : 走吧，大哥！我们去折腾我们最喜欢的咖啡师！

lines.en: scene black
Otoha and I set off toward the cafe and I feel slightly bad for Molly in not giving her the title of my favorite barista.
lines.zh: 我和 Otoha 朝咖啡厅出发，我有点替 Molly 过意不去——我没把“我最喜欢的咖啡师”这个头衔给她。

lines.en: But, to be fair, Molly is very bad at her job.
lines.zh: 不过说句公道话，Molly 干这活儿确实很糟糕。

lines.en: I can’t even remember if she’s ever actually sold me anything.
lines.zh: 我甚至记不起来她到底有没有真的卖给我过什么东西。

lines.en: At least Rin tries.
lines.zh: 至少 Rin 还会试着干。

lines.en: Tries a little too hard sometimes, sure. But she tries.
lines.zh: 当然，有时候努力得有点过头。但她起码在努力。

lines.en: A short while later, Otoha and I wind up outside the cafe and exchange one final look of platonic sibling love before walking in and ruining (Or making) Rin’s day.
lines.zh: 没过多久，我和 Otoha 站到了咖啡厅门外，在走进去毁掉（或者说成就）Rin 这一天之前，交换了最后一个纯洁的兄妹之爱的眼神。

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == False:
scene otohacafetrip11
: Yo! Morning.
lines.zh: : 哟！早啊。

lines.en: : One copyrighted frozen beverage please.
lines.zh: : 来一杯侵权的冰饮，谢谢。

lines.en: : Well I definitely don’t like this.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我肯定不喜欢这样。

lines.en: : It’s cool. We’re family now.
lines.zh: : 没事。我们现在是一家人了。

lines.en: : Does Nodoka know?
lines.zh: : Nodoka 知道吗？

lines.en: : I demand customer service.
lines.zh: : 我要求顾客服务。

lines.en: : Not yet. We’re trying to keep it a secret from her.
lines.zh: : 还不知道。我们打算先瞒着她。

lines.en: : You want in as well?
lines.zh: : 你也想加入吗？

lines.en: scene otohacafetrip12
: Yes. Immediately.
lines.zh: : 想。马上去办。

lines.en: : Tell me what I must do.
lines.zh: : 告诉我该怎么做。

lines.en: : Nothing {i}that{/i} serious...
lines.zh: : 没{i}那么{/i}严重啦……

lines.en: : Just...you know. Maybe letting me play here sometime?
lines.zh: : 就是……你知道的。能不能让我在这儿弹一次？

lines.en: : It’s a little too cold out to be playing in the park right now, and Sensei came up with the idea of maybe playing in the cafe.
lines.zh: : 现在外面太冷了，不适合在公园弹，是 Sensei 出的主意，说也许可以在咖啡厅弹。

lines.en: : If that’s cool, I mean. I totally understand if it’s not.
lines.zh: : 如果可以的话，我是说。不行我也完全理解。

lines.en: else:
scene otohacafetrip13
: Yo! Morning.
lines.zh: : 哟！早啊。

lines.en: : One copyrighted frozen beverage please.
lines.zh: : 来一杯侵权的冰饮，谢谢。

lines.en: : Are you fucking kidding me?
lines.zh: : 你他妈在跟我开玩笑吧？

lines.en: : Was the first time not enough?
lines.zh: : 第一次还不够吗？

lines.en: : You’re really going to do this again?
lines.zh: : 你还真要再来一遍？

lines.en: scene otohacafetrip14
: Wait, what? What’s going on?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？怎么回事？

lines.en: : Is everything okay? We didn’t come here to mess with you or anything.
lines.zh: : 一切都还好吗？我们不是来捣乱什么的。

lines.en: : Maybe {i}you{/i} didn’t.
lines.zh: : 也许{i}你{/i}不是。

lines.en: : It wouldn’t be the first time Sensei decided to start getting close to someone I...am friends with, though.
lines.zh: : 不过 Sensei 忽然开始跟我……朋友套近乎，这也不是第一次了。

lines.en: : Yeah. This probably wasn’t a good idea after all.
lines.zh: : 是啊。看来这主意本来就不太好。

lines.en: scene otohacafetrip15
: Well...I’m really sorry if we upset you...
lines.zh: : 那个……如果我们让你不开心了，真的很抱歉……

lines.en: : But we’re really just here to ask if it would be okay for me to...maybe play in the cafe sometime.
lines.zh: : 不过我们真的只是想来问问，我能不能……找个时间在这儿弹一次。

lines.en: : It’s a little too cold out to be playing in the park right now, and Sensei came up with the idea of maybe playing here.
lines.zh: : 现在外面太冷了，不适合在公园弹，是 Sensei 出的主意，说也许可以在这儿弹。

lines.en: : If that’s cool, I mean. I totally understand if it’s not.
lines.zh: : 如果可以的话，我是说。不行我也完全理解。

lines.en: scene otohacafetrip16
: Oh my God, yeah! Totally!
lines.zh: : 我的天，当然可以！完全没问题！

lines.en: : I mean, it’s not really up to me. But my manager like, really has a thing for [teenage]girls. So you’re basically already locked in.
lines.zh: : 我是说，这事儿也不全由我说了算。不过我们店长，那叫一个喜欢[teenage]女孩。所以你基本已经内定了。

lines.en: scene otohacafetrip17
: Hell yeah! Mission complete!
lines.zh: : 太爽了！任务完成！

lines.en: : Wait, you know about that?
lines.zh: : 等等，你知道这事？

lines.en: : Dude, why else would she hire exclusively cute girls? We work in a cafe, not a topless bar.
lines.zh: : 老兄，不然她干嘛只招可爱的女孩？我们开的是咖啡厅，又不是无上装酒吧。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure Haruka thinks she’s managed to hide it from you.
lines.zh: : 我敢说 Haruka 以为自己瞒住你了。

lines.en: : Then she should probably stop “accidentally” sending pictures of her in her underwear to our group chat and saying they were meant for someone else.
lines.zh: : 那她大概该别再“手滑”把她穿内衣的照片发到我们群里，然后说本来是要发给别人的了。

lines.en: scene otohacafetrip18
: You know, maybe we should think of other places just in case. The cafe is cool and all, but-
lines.zh: : 我说，要不我们还是再想想别的地方以防万一吧。咖啡厅是挺不错，不过——

lines.en: : Don’t you dare chicken out after coming this far.
lines.zh: : 都走到这一步了，你敢临阵脱逃试试。

lines.en: : Think of what Niki would do.
lines.zh: : 想想 Niki 会怎么做。

lines.en: : Is like...{i}everyone{/i} on this side of town weird, or?...
lines.zh: : 是……{i}所有人{/i}在镇上这一边都这么怪吗，还是？……

lines.en: : If you think this is bad, you should take a visit to the old district.
lines.zh: : 你要是觉得这就够糟了，那该去老城区逛逛。

lines.en: scene otohacafetrip19
: Uhh...I’m good. That place kinda creeps me out.
lines.zh: : 呃……算了。那地方让我有点发毛。

lines.en: : I’ll try talking to Haruka about it. I’m sure she’ll say it’s fine, but...Hey, you never really know.
lines.zh: : 我会试着跟 Haruka 说说的。我敢肯定她会答应，不过……嘿，这种事谁说得准呢。

lines.en: : Do you guys need anything? I’m in charge today, so I can give you extra shots for free or something.
lines.zh: : 你们要点什么吗？今天我负责，可以免费给你们多加几份浓缩什么的。

lines.en: : Two “Rin Specials” please.
lines.zh: : 来两杯“Rin 特调”，谢谢。

lines.en: scene otohacafetrip20
: You got it, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 没问题，Sensei。

lines.en: : Go sit down. I’ll bring over something crazy in just a minute.
lines.zh: : 去坐吧。我马上给你们端点厉害的东西过来。

lines.en: : What did you just order me?
lines.zh: : 你刚给我点了什么？

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it.
lines.zh: : 别担心。

lines.en: : But...I’m lactose intolerant.
lines.zh: : 可……我乳糖不耐受啊。

lines.en: scene black
Otoha and I make our way to a table only slightly touched by the sun and take our respective places at opposite ends.
lines.zh: 我和 Otoha 走到一张只被阳光沾到一点的桌子旁，各自在两端坐下。

lines.en: Rin shows up a few moments later with two different drinks and sets one in front of each of us before rushing back to the counter to help another customer...
lines.zh: 片刻之后，Rin 端着两杯不同的饮品出现，在我们面前各放了一杯，然后又赶回柜台去招呼另一位客人……

lines.en: scene otohacafetrip21
: So, I might as well get it out of the way now and say thanks for coming up with this idea.
lines.zh: : 那我就趁现在说了吧——谢谢你想到这个主意。

lines.en: : Don’t thank me until it’s at least been approved.
lines.zh: : 等至少批下来了再谢我吧。

lines.en: : But you guys said it yourself, I’m basically locked in.
lines.zh: : 可你们自己也说了，我基本已经内定了。

lines.en: : Sure. But what if Haruka thinks you’re so attractive that she won’t be able to contain herself around you?
lines.zh: : 是啊。可万一 Haruka 觉得你太有魅力，在你身边把持不住自己呢？

lines.en: : That could affect business.
lines.zh: : 那会影响生意的。

lines.en: : Well?
lines.zh: : 怎么样？

lines.en: : Let’s talk about something else.
lines.zh: : 我们换个话题吧。

lines.en: : Sure. Let’s talk about Rin instead.
lines.zh: : 好啊。那就聊聊 Rin 吧。

lines.en: scene otohacafetrip22
: Welp, guess the chance for a normal conversation topic is off the table.
lines.zh: : 好吧，看来正常话题是没指望了。

lines.en: : How are things going for the two of you now that you don’t live far enough apart to come up with excuses for not hanging out with her?
lines.zh: : 你们俩现在住得没那么远了，找不到借口不跟她出去玩，相处得怎么样？

lines.en: scene otohacafetrip23
: Wait, what? What are you talking about?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？你在说什么？

lines.en: : Weren’t the two of you supposed to go on a trip to some arcade in your neck of the woods a while back?
lines.zh: : 你们俩不是前阵子该去你家附近那家游戏厅玩一趟吗？

lines.en: : I wound up going in your place.
lines.zh: : 结果是我替你去的。

lines.en: : Yeah, but that was because my parents wouldn’t let me go. It had nothing to do with me trying to get out of it.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可那是因为我爸妈不让我去。跟我躲着不去一点关系都没有。

lines.en: : I thought it sounded really fun and we’ve already made new plans to go there together.
lines.zh: : 我听着觉得挺好玩的，而且我们已经重新约好要一起去了。

lines.en: : Oh, really? I didn’t hear about that.
lines.zh: : 哦，是吗？这我倒没听说。

lines.en: : Yeah. I was never trying to avoid her or anything if that’s what you were thinking.
lines.zh: : 嗯。你要是以为我在躲她什么的，那可没有。

lines.en: : Well, that’s good.
lines.zh: : 那挺好的。

lines.en: : She didn’t really let it show, but she was pretty upset that day.
lines.zh: : 她没怎么表现出来，但那天她挺难过的。

lines.en: scene otohacafetrip24
: Oh come on...I like, {i}just{/i} stopped feeling bad about that...
lines.zh: : 拜托……我{i}才刚{/i}不为那件事内疚了……

lines.en: if rinbetrayed == False:
scene otohacafetrip25
: Besides...didn’t getting to go in my place kind of like...work out for you or whatever?
lines.zh: : 再说……能替我去，对你来说不也……算是赚到了之类的吗？

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean that like...you guys kissed or something, right?
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……你们亲了还是什么的，对吧？

lines.en: Rin told her that?
lines.zh: Rin 告诉她了？

lines.en: Why?
lines.zh: 为什么？

lines.en: I figured she’d be worried about that ruining her chances with Otoha.
lines.zh: 我以为她会担心这事毁了她跟 Otoha 的机会。

lines.en: Maybe she just...doesn’t want to hide anything from her?...
lines.zh: 也许她只是……不想对她隐瞒什么？……

lines.en: I don’t know.
lines.zh: 我不知道。

lines.en: : Yeah. We did.
lines.zh: : 嗯。亲了。

lines.en: : Yeah. So like...sorry if it seems like I’m trying to take your place or something. Even if that was only a one time thing.
lines.zh: : 嗯。所以……如果看起来像是我想抢你的位置什么的，那我道歉。就算那只是个一次性的事。

lines.en: : I don’t think you’re trying to take my place.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得你在抢我的位置。

lines.en: : Hell, I don’t even fully understand what my “place” with Rin is.
lines.zh: : 见鬼，我连自己跟 Rin 的“位置”到底是什么都没完全搞明白。

lines.en: : I just wasn’t sure what to think about how you two were doing specifically now that you’re seeing each other a lot more.
lines.zh: : 我只是拿不准该怎么看你们俩现在的状态，尤其是你们见面的次数多了这么多以后。

lines.en: scene otohacafetrip26
: More or less the same as we were before.
lines.zh: : 跟以前差不多吧。

lines.en: : Just now I don’t have to worry about the pressure of being her first kiss if we {i}do{/i} wind up becoming anything more than what we are now.
lines.zh: : 只是现在，万一我们{i}真的{/i}发展成比现在更多的关系，我就不用再担心「夺走她初吻」的压力了。

lines.en: : Wait, so you’re okay with what happened between us? There’s no lingering resentment or anything?
lines.zh: : 等等，那你对我们之间发生的事没意见？没有一点耿耿于怀什么的？

lines.en: scene otohacafetrip27
: Why would I resent anything about two people who like each other kissing for a few minutes?
lines.zh: : 两个互相喜欢的人亲了几分钟，我有什么好怨恨的？

lines.en: : Things like that happen.
lines.zh: : 这种事总会发生。

lines.en: : It’s not like me and her are dating.
lines.zh: : 我和她又不是在交往。

lines.en: : Like, if I made out with Nodoka, I’m sure Rin wouldn’t be upset at all.
lines.zh: : 比如说，就算我跟 Nodoka 热吻，我敢说 Rin 也一点都不会生气。

lines.en: : I don't think that’s true. She likes you a lot.
lines.zh: : 我可不这么认为。她很喜欢你。

lines.en: : She likes {i}you{/i} a lot, too.
lines.zh: : 她也{i}很{/i}喜欢你。

lines.en: : It’s like she’s going through some...intense war inside of her head where you and me are duking it out for the upper hand.
lines.zh: : 就好像她脑子里正在打一场……激烈的战争，你和我在里面互殴，争个高下。

lines.en: : Just neither one of us is actually {i}fighting{/i} and it’s all on her.
lines.zh: : 只是我们俩其实谁都没在{i}打{/i}，全都是她一个人在折腾。

lines.en: : Pretty good material for a song, now that I think about it.
lines.zh: : 现在想想，这倒是个挺不错的写歌素材。

lines.en: : Stop being so mature and cool or I’m going to start liking you too.
lines.zh: : 别这么成熟又酷了，不然我也要开始喜欢你了。

lines.en: : But you’re my brother. What would our parents think?
lines.zh: : 可你是我哥啊。我们爸妈会怎么想？

lines.en: : Haven’t I been telling you this whole time that they don’t matter anymore?
lines.zh: : 我不是一直都在跟你说，他们已经不重要了吗？

lines.en: : All that matters is {i}us{/i}, my dearest Otoha.
lines.zh: : 重要的只有{i}我们{/i}，我最亲爱的 Otoha。

lines.en: scene otohacafetrip28
: Okay. I’m uncomfortable now.
lines.zh: : 好了。我现在不舒服了。

lines.en: : Let’s just talk about music or something instead...
lines.zh: : 我们还是聊音乐什么的吧……

lines.en: else:
: There’s no need to feel bad. She still really likes you.
lines.zh: : 不用觉得过意不去。她还是很喜欢你。

lines.en: : The second you texted her that night, she completely stopped paying attention to me.
lines.zh: : 那天晚上你一给她发消息，她就完全不再理我了。

lines.en: : And I don’t blame her after how I’ve treated her feelings in the past.
lines.zh: : 考虑到我以前是怎么对待她的感情的，我也不怪她。

lines.en: scene otohacafetrip29
: If you’ve messed with her feelings in the past, why do you seem so worried about them now?
lines.zh: : 既然你以前伤过她的感情，为什么现在看起来这么在意？

lines.en: : Because I’m naturally a horrible person and you’re not.
lines.zh: : 因为我天生就是个糟糕的人，而你不是。

lines.en: : Rin still has faith in you. So if {i}you{/i} wind up screwing her over as well, she’s probably just doomed to romantic misfortune for the rest of eternity.
lines.zh: : Rin 还对你抱有信心。所以如果{i}你{/i}也把她伤了，那她大概就注定要永远倒霉在感情上了。

lines.en: scene otohacafetrip30
: That’s putting way too much pressure on me, Sensei. That’s not fair.
lines.zh: : 这给我的压力太大了，Sensei。这不公平。

lines.en: : Rin’s happiness shouldn’t be entirely dependent on either one of us reciprocating her feelings.
lines.zh: : Rin 的幸福不该完全取决于我们俩有没有一个回应她的感情。

lines.en: : I don’t think you’re a bad guy. I just think you might do bad things every once in a while.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得你是坏人。我只是觉得你偶尔会做些坏事。

lines.en: : I’m no different.
lines.zh: : 我也一样。

lines.en: : If someone’s feelings get hurt as the result of my actions, like they did with Rin and the arcade trip, I’m obviously going to be upset.
lines.zh: : 如果因为我的举动，别人的感情受了伤——就像 Rin 和那次游戏厅之行那样，我当然会难过。

lines.en: : But I’m not going to give up on everything I want just to make sure they don’t get upset anymore.
lines.zh: : 但我不会为了让他们不再难过，就放弃我想要的一切。

lines.en: : I have no idea how I feel about Rin right now. And there’s a good chance I won’t for a while. I just...
lines.zh: : 我现在完全不知道自己对 Rin 是什么感觉。而且很有可能很长一段时间内都不会知道。我只是……

lines.en: : I have no idea.
lines.zh: : 我一点头绪都没有。

lines.en: : Everything is all so new to me all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 一切突然之间对我来说都太新了。

lines.en: : So just let me kinda...take it all in for a little while, okay?
lines.zh: : 所以就让我……先慢慢消化一阵子，好吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. Sure. The way I worded that was pretty bad anyway.
lines.zh: : 嗯。好。反正我那话说得也挺糟糕的。

lines.en: : I just meant there’s no need to get down about upsetting her since she still thinks you’re the coolest girl she’s ever met.
lines.zh: : 我只是想说，你不用因为让她难过而消沉，因为她仍然觉得你是她见过最酷的女孩。

lines.en: scene otohacafetrip31
: That really seems to be a recurring theme these days, huh?
lines.zh: : 最近这好像成了个反复出现的主题了，是吧？

lines.en: : Why does everyone think I’m so cool? Does playing guitar and singing really help that much?
lines.zh: : 为什么大家都觉得我这么酷？弹吉他和唱歌真的那么加分吗？

lines.en: : I don’t know. I still think it’s the rings.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我还是觉得是那些戒指的功劳。

lines.en: : Bring up the rings one more time and I’m cutting my fingers off.
lines.zh: : 你再提一次戒指，我就把手指剁了。

lines.en: scene black
Otoha and I wind up talking until an orange glow consumes Kumon-mi and daytime begins to exit stage left.
lines.zh: 我和 Otoha 就这么聊着，直到一片橙色的光吞没了 Kumon-mi，白昼开始从舞台左侧退场。

lines.en: The cafe stays busy throughout the morning, so Rin never gets a chance to spend any time with us.
lines.zh: 整个上午咖啡厅都很忙，所以 Rin 一直没机会陪我们。

lines.en: I’m a little surprised that she was able to prioritize work over hanging out, though.
lines.zh: 不过我有点意外，她居然能把工作放在跟我们玩之前。

lines.en: But I guess she might be trying to prove herself or something since Haruka was confident enough to leave the cafe in her hands for the day.
lines.zh: 不过我猜她大概是想证明自己什么的，毕竟 Haruka 放心把咖啡厅交给她管一整天。

lines.en: Either that or she’s just starting to realize that Otoha needs her space to thrive.
lines.zh: 要么就是她开始意识到，Otoha 需要自己的空间才能成长。

lines.en: I don’t know if I’d go as far as saying she’s truly “out of the cage” yet-
lines.zh: 我还不敢说她已经真正“出了笼子”——

lines.en: But Otoha's cage is extremely large.
lines.zh: 但 Otoha 的笼子非常大。

lines.en: So I’m sure she still has plenty of room to fly and just...hasn’t found the door yet.
lines.zh: 所以我敢肯定，她还有的是地方可以飞，只是……还没找到那扇门而已。

lines.zh: {i}Otoha 的好感度提升到了 [otoha_love]！{/i}
